influences.name: Bob Moore
influences.context: Part of this work mentality perhaps came from his father, Bob Moore, a Nashville session musician who was featured on countless country and early rock recordings. R. Stevie witnessed a massive quantity of recording early on in his life and later went on to produce his own impressive volume of work.

influences.name: Jad Fair
influences.context: We met at Maxwell's in Hoboken at one of my gigs because he was friends with Jad Fair of Half Japanese.

influences.name: Robert Fripp
influences.context: Robert Fripp of King Crimson and Brian Eno were big on that as a way of creating art itself — of spontaneity and happy accidents.
